bosses.name: Noxxion
bosses.general: Toxic Volley poisons everyone and Uppercut; now and then he splits into small Spawns and can't be hurt until they die.
bosses.tank: Gather the Spawns when he splits.
bosses.dps: Area attacks on the Spawns, then him.

bosses.name: Lord Vyletongue
bosses.general: Satyr lord with his guards: blinks around and fires Multi-Shot.
bosses.tank: Grab his guards; chase him when he blinks.

bosses.name: Celebras the Cursed
bosses.general: Wrath, Entangling Roots, and he summons treants.
bosses.dps: Kill the treants, interrupt his Wrath.

bosses.name: Landslide
bosses.general: Giant rock elemental: Knock Away and Trample, calls small rock adds.
bosses.tank: Back to a wall, grab the adds.
bosses.dps: Adds first if loose, else Landslide.

bosses.name: Tinkerer Gizlock
bosses.general: Goblin engineer: a dragon gun burns everyone in front, and bombs.
bosses.tank: Face him away from the group.
bosses.dps: Spread out, stay out of his front.

bosses.name: Rotgrip
bosses.general: Huge crocolisk in the water: Puncture and Fatal Bite.

bosses.name: Princess Theradras
bosses.general: Dust Field hurts everyone near her, she throws Boulders at range and Repulsive Gaze knocks back.
bosses.tank: Hold her, step back out of the Dust Field and pull her with you.
bosses.dps: Melee step out of the Dust Field; ranged spread for Boulder.
